description: Hand a task in words to Finai, Final's own AI agent, and get its finished answer. It runs as this connection's user on its company, within the allowed packs, and uses Final's tools itself (looking records up, creating products, building or deploying an app). Use it for multi-step merchant jobs you would rather describe than orchestrate; call tools directly when you need the raw data. Pass conversationId to continue an earlier thread.

conversationId.description: A conversationId from an earlier ask_finai result, to continue that thread.

task.description: What to do or find out, in plain language, with every id or value Finai needs.
